question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap as bundled Control UI/plugin work, and which subitems should instead move to external plugin, skill, or ClawHub paths?
rationale: The roadmap is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it crosses bundled plugin scope, browser sandboxing, persisted state, command binding, role visibility, and plugin distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor Staged Dashboard Work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review the subissues and PR stack in dependency order, and require explicit storage, upgrade, and security proof before any bundled surface lands.

options.title: Narrow To Extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, app bundles, and skills to prove themselves through ClawHub or external packages first.

options.title: Pause The Roadmap
options.body: Defer or close the dashboard roadmap if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Staged Dashboard Work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review the subissues and PR stack in dependency order, and require explicit storage, upgrade, and security proof before any bundled surface lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the recently merged plugin-tab/Logbook seam and adjacent Control UI navigation work that the dashboard stack builds on.
